products.name: Fascia Roller
products.tagline: Sixty seconds. Feet that feel like yours again.
products.summary: A textured roller built for the soles of your feet — the one part of you that never gets stretched. Roll for a minute after shoes come off and the tightness in your arch, heel and calves starts letting go.
bullets: Over 400 pressure points work the arch, heel and fascia at once
Weighted core keeps it still on tile, wood or gym floor
30 cm and 380 g — it lives in a carry-on
Use it barefoot, in socks, or as a warm-up before running
specs: Wipe clean with a damp cloth

products.name: Posture Corrector
products.tagline: Undo the eight hours you spent hunched.
products.summary: A figure-eight brace that pulls your shoulders back into the position they were designed to hold. Wear it for fifteen minutes a day and your back relearns the shape — no foam roller, no chiropractor appointment.
bullets: Figure-eight straps open the chest without pinching the underarm
Breathable mesh panel sits flat under a shirt
Eight points of adjustment — set it once and forget it
Fifteen minutes a day is the entire protocol

products.name: Heel Support Wrap
products.summary: The sharp pain of that first step out of bed is the plantar fascia complaining. An anatomical gel heel cup takes the impact, and a compression strap lifts the arch so the fascia stops being stretched all day.
bullets: Gel heel cup absorbs impact on hard floors and concrete
Compression strap wraps the arch and takes load off the fascia
Wear it barefoot, in socks, or inside a trainer
Sold as a properly shaped pair — left and right differ

products.name: Heat Therapy Brace
products.tagline: Three heat levels. One warm shoulder at 9pm.
products.summary: Heat and gentle vibration in a wrap that fits a shoulder or a knee. It runs off USB, so it works on the sofa, in the car or from a power bank in a tent — and it shuts itself off after thirty minutes.
bullets: USB-powered: power bank, laptop, wall adapter
Heats in under 60 seconds, auto shut-off at 30 minutes
One strap, two joints: shoulder or knee
specs: Wipe the shell, do not submerge
